title: Degree bound for a binary slice
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\mathbb F_2^{n+1}\to\mathbb F_2$, and let $b\in\mathbb F_2$. If the algebraic degree of $f$ in its algebraic normal form is at most $k$, then the algebraic degree of the function $x\mapsto f(b,x)$ is at most $k$.
hypotheses_covered: the algebraic degree of $f$ is at most $k$
